newsitem.title: UK: UK names ABP preferred bidder for Ipswich.
newsitem.headline: UK names ABP preferred bidder for Ipswich.

text.p: Britain's Department of Transport on Friday named Associated British Ports Holding Plc as the preferred bidder for the port of Ipswich, ABP said.

ABP said it had bid 24.4 million stg for Ipswich Port Limited. It said the bid, after deducting the sale levy of 50 percent due to the government and privatisation costs, valued the port at 12 million stg.
ABP, which owns and operates 22 ports around the country, said it expected Ipswich to become the main centre for its east Anglian port operations, particularly serving the agriculture industry.

"Although the Port of Ipswich is expected to show only a small profit for 1996 (before privatisation costs), prospects for growth are now positive, given its excellent location and substantial spare capacity," ABP chairman Keith Stuart said in a statement.
